static_findings.title: Exact reference-file hash match

evidence.text: SHA-256 ae64af21fa9c77327dca98ac33d13279659d9989141352e3a35b83edad76ec03; label: VETO inert development fixture (NOT verified malware)

static_findings.rationale: File bytes match a configured reference exactly.
static_findings.limitation: The catalog's provenance determines the meaning; a match alone is not malware attribution.

static_findings.title: Dynamic PHP evaluation
static_findings.rationale: Evaluates generated PHP code; review the source of its argument.
static_findings.limitation: Some legitimate loaders evaluate generated code.

static_findings.title: Operating-system command execution
static_findings.limitation: Maintenance tools may legitimately launch processes.

static_findings.title: Encoded or compressed payload handling
static_findings.rationale: Encoding can conceal code or data and merits contextual review.
static_findings.limitation: Encoding is common in legitimate plugins.

static_findings.title: User-controlled dynamic include
static_findings.rationale: An include path appears to come directly from request data.
static_findings.limitation: Validation elsewhere is not resolved by this scanner.

static_findings.title: WordPress account creation capability
static_findings.rationale: Can create accounts; correlate with intended plugin functionality.
static_findings.limitation: Registration and membership plugins legitimately create users.

static_findings.title: WordPress scheduled-task registration
static_findings.rationale: Can schedule recurring or delayed activity.
static_findings.limitation: Scheduled tasks are normal for many plugins.

static_findings.title: Outbound request capability
static_findings.rationale: May contact external services; destination and context need review.
static_findings.limitation: This is capability evidence, not an observed network connection.

static_findings.title: Filesystem mutation capability
static_findings.limitation: Caching, installation, and updates commonly write files.

static_findings.title: Encoded data passed to evaluation
static_findings.rationale: An eval/decode chain can conceal executable PHP.
static_findings.limitation: Raw-byte pattern; comments, strings, or legitimate loaders can match.

static_findings.title: Request data passed to evaluation
static_findings.rationale: Direct request-to-eval syntax can permit arbitrary code execution.
static_findings.limitation: Raw-byte pattern; reachability and input validation are not established.

limitations: Static indicators are not proof of maliciousness or safety.
No plugin execution, dynamic monitoring, or runtime observations in Phase 1.
PHP checks are lexical, not AST, data-flow, reachability, or vulnerability analysis.
Raw YARA may match comments or inert strings; encoded/indirect behavior can evade rules.
Only the configured local hash references are checked; an empty catalog provides no known-sample detection.
